_comment: Reference stage definitions. The skill itself does NOT consume this file directly. The gate-map templates in templates/design/ derive their default stage names from this catalog. Orchestrators can override stage names entirely in their project's gate-map.json.

stages.name: requirements_analysis
stages.description: Define the problem, justify AI, identify stakeholders, secure approval

stages.name: application_design
stages.description: Map user journey, decide on human oversight model, identify upstream/contributing stakeholders

stages.name: functional_design
stages.description: Fairness assessment, explainability, privacy, safety, veracity/robustness design

stages.name: nfr_requirements
stages.description: Data governance, evaluation criteria, release planning

stages.name: infrastructure_design
stages.description: Operations, monitoring, incident response, decommissioning plan

stages.name: code_generation
stages.description: Enforcement of design decisions in code; user feedback affordance; transparency

stages.name: build_and_test
stages.description: Test coverage, traceability, go/no-go review, system card, monitoring wiring
